evidence: The delegated runner has no global lock, admission ledger, attempt quota, or free-space guard.
run_attempt creates its root workspace before opening or validating the receipt.
Every exception preserves that workspace, including a nonexistent or malformed receipt.
The same unpublished attempt name may be submitted repeatedly, and distinct names may execute expensive scorers concurrently.
A bounded simulation submitted the same missing receipt three times and produced three preserved failure directories.
high.affected_gate: W9 delegated-runner host safety and authoritative attempt preservation
high.reproduction_instructions: Redirect state constants to temporary directories, call run_attempt with one missing receipt and the same valid attempt name three times, and observe three distinct preserved failure directories. Inspect the candidate for lock, quota, or free-space admission; none exists.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Acquire one root-owned global lock before workspace creation. Fully validate and BLS-check the bounded receipt before authoritative state. Enforce a preregistered one-shot admission rule, disk-free floor, and bounded retention. Prove concurrent and malformed calls do not enter scoring or create failure artifacts.

medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Reject dot components and require a canonical path beneath the approved root, or use dirfd-relative openat2 confinement; add traversal and symlinked-ancestor tests.

high.evidence: run_attempt stages results at workspace/first, then validate_published_attempt requires the staging basename to equal attempt_name. Every otherwise-successful execution therefore fails before rename. The unit fixtures already use the expected basename and miss this path.
high.reproduction_instructions: Execute run_attempt end to end with mocked matching scorer outputs; observe published-attempt identity mismatch at prepublication validation.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Stage the final result tree with the exact attempt basename and add an end-to-end mocked success test proving publication reaches the exact destination while a mismatched basename fails before rename.

high.evidence: The delegated runner has no root-owned lock, one-shot admission, scorer-process containment, disk floor, or retention bound. Distinct calls can overlap two 7200-second scorer processes each and preserve unbounded failures; the staging-name defect makes every otherwise-valid run add another failure.
high.affected_gate: W9 root delegation and host safety
high.reproduction_instructions: Use temporary roots and mocked long-running scorers, start two distinct attempts, and observe both reach scorer startup. Re-submit or inject post-score failures and observe unbounded preserved workspaces.
high.proposed_acceptance_test: Acquire a root-owned global lock before workspace/scoring; bind one candidate and randomness round to a one-shot attempt; contain and clean scorer descendants; enforce a disk-free floor and bounded retention; test concurrency, replay, timeout descendants, and failure volume.

medium.evidence: The installer writes the sudoers destination with ordinary install and cleanup can remove a pre-existing file after a later failure.
medium.reproduction_instructions: In an isolated prefix, seed the sudoers destination and inject a failure after replacement; the original bytes are not restored.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Require destinations absent or exactly approved, publish sudoers with no-replace semantics, fsync parent directories, and failure-inject each stage to prove complete install or byte-exact restoration.

medium.evidence: Root failure workspaces improve preservation but malformed attempts still lack a complete authoritative evidence triple.
medium.reproduction_instructions: Submit a structurally invalid bounded request in a test prefix and inspect the preserved outputs.
medium.proposed_acceptance_test: Emit a minimal immutable failure manifest, raw row, and summary with reason and identities for each admitted authoritative attempt.
